 Fresh To You Sausage Biscuit Sandwiches Recalled For Listeria
 November 9, 2026 by Linda Larsen 
 Fresh To You Sausage Biscuit Sandwiches are being recalled because they may be contaminated with Listeria monocytogenes. No illnesses have been reported to the company to date in connection with the consumption of the product. The recalling firm si Fresh & Ready Foods of Renton, Washington.
 This recall is in connection with a recall issued by CH Guenther & Son for some biscuit products that may have been contaminated with the pathogen. The biscuit was used as an ingredient only in this recalled product.
 The recalled product is Fresh To You Sausage Egg & Cheese Biscuit Sandwiches. They were produced at the facility in Renton, Washington and distributed in the states of Washington and Oregon to employee break rooms, refrigerated vending machines, and cafeterias between October 25 and November 4, 2026.
 The biscuits are packaged in a 4.6 ounce clear plastic film package. The SKU number is 3100048. The UPC number that is printed on the product label is 8 405493 0168 4. The best by date is Fresh Thru 11/07/26 to 11/19/26, which is on the front label of the package.
 If you bought this product, do not eat it, even if you plan to reheat it thoroughly because of the possibility of cross-contamination. You can throw the sandwich away in a secure trash can after first double bagging it so other people can’t see it, or you can take it back to the place of purchase for a full refund.
 If you ate this sandwich, monitor your health for the symptoms of listeriosis for the next 70 days. If you do get sick, see your doctor.
